subaccounts.intro: Use subaccounts to give each project its own SOCKS5 credentials and usage limit for dynamic residential proxies.
subaccounts.usernameHint: A SOCKS5 username combines the main account and subaccount names, for example {account}.shop01.
subaccounts.quotaHint: Enabled and disabled accounts both count.
subaccounts.quotaFull: All {quota} subaccount slots are used. Enabled and disabled accounts both count.
subaccounts.activeHint: Disabled accounts cannot start new connections.
subaccounts.usageHint: Across all subaccounts. 1 GB = 1 billion bytes.
subaccounts.name: Subaccount name
subaccounts.remarkPlaceholder: Describe how this account is used
subaccounts.disableImpact: Disabling this account blocks new connections. Existing connections stay open and usage continues to be counted. The account still uses a slot.
subaccounts.enableImpact: New connections still need sufficient tenant balance and available usage. Existing connections stay open.
subaccounts.passwordImpact: New connections use the new password. Existing connections stay open.
subaccounts.limitImpact: At the limit, new connections are blocked and existing usage continues to be counted.
subaccounts.limitEditHint: You can raise or remove the limit. Usage so far is {used} GB.
subaccounts.nameRule: Use 4–8 lowercase letters or digits, starting with a letter. The name is fixed after creation.
subaccounts.passwordRule: Use 6–12 ASCII letters and digits, with at least one of each.
subaccounts.remarkRule: The note can be up to 512 bytes.
subaccounts.limitRule: Enter a valid number of GB with up to 9 decimal places.
subaccounts.belowUsage: The limit must be at least the current usage.
subaccounts.lowerLimit: You can raise or remove the current limit.
subaccounts.copyFailed: Copy failed. Check your browser’s clipboard permissions.

errors.INVALID_SUBACCOUNT_NAME: Use 4–8 lowercase letters or digits, starting with a letter. The name is fixed after creation.
errors.SUBACCOUNT_NAME_EXISTS: This subaccount name is already in use.
errors.INVALID_PROXY_PASSWORD: Use 6–12 ASCII letters and digits, with at least one of each.
errors.INVALID_SUBACCOUNT_REMARK: The note can be up to 512 bytes.
errors.INVALID_SUBACCOUNT_LIMIT: You can raise or remove the current limit.
errors.SUBACCOUNT_LIMIT_BELOW_USAGE: The limit must be at least the current usage.
